title: HazeSMP.net
description: A European network offering a wide variety of servers, such as Economy SMP and FFA.
body:
# HazeSMP Network - Economy, FreeForall & Events!

A competitive European Minecraft network offering unique custom gameplay experiences, active PvP systems, large-scale wars, custom weapons, advanced economy mechanics, and frequent community events.

Whether you enjoy grinding economy, intense PvP, SMP wars, or custom combat systems — this network delivers a highly optimized and feature-rich experience.


---


# **Economy (Server Mode)**

Our Economy SMP is heavily inspired by modern DonutSMP-style gameplay and includes a massive amount of custom content and progression systems.

## **Core Systems**

* Advanced Auction House
* Order System
* Custom Shops
* Player Settings
* Economy Progression
* Trading Systems
* Secure Storage Features
* Balanced PvP Economy

## **Special Features**

* Airdrops with valuable loot
* Dealer NPC System
* Custom Weapons
* Daily & Progress Rewards
* Kits System
* Bounties & Wanted Features
* Multiple Custom Crates

## **Crates & Loot**

More than 6 unique crates containing:

* Mythic Tools
* Diamond Gear
* Netherite Equipment
* Rare PvP Items
* Special Utility Items

### **Hourly KeyAll**

Every hour all players receive free crate keys with useful standard rewards.

### **Ultra Crate**

A special ultra crate featuring:

* Powerful Netherite Armor
* Custom Attributes
* Enhanced PvP Effects
* High-end Equipment

  

---



# **FreeForAll (Server Mode)**

A highly custom Free For All server with modern combat mechanics and intense PvP gameplay.

## **FFA Features**

* Massive Warzone
* Diamond SMP Based PvP
* EconomyX System
* Upgrade Progression
* Custom Crates
* Netherite Upgrades

## **Custom Weapons Rotation**

Unique rotating weapons including:

* Smash Mace
* Dash Sword
* Orbital Strike Cannon
* Stun Axe
* Angel Totem
* And many more custom weapons

## **Extra Systems**

* Wanted System
* Bounties
* Resin Clicker for starter money
* Competitive PvP Progression
* Risk vs Reward Gameplay



---




# **Advanced Protection & Fair Gameplay**

The network uses a powerful and highly optimized anti-cheat system focused on fair gameplay.

## **Protection Includes**

* Advanced AntiCheat
* Anti ESP
* Anti Freecam
* Exploit Prevention
* Optimized Combat Detection

---

# **Media & Community Friendly**

We actively support:

* Streamers
* YouTubers
* Content Creators
* Media Partnerships
* Creator Collaborations

Our network is open for media cooperation and community growth projects.

---

# **Massive Events**

We regularly host huge events on dedicated external event servers.

## **Event Features**

* Special PvP Tournaments
* Large Community Events
* Custom Minigame Events
* Exclusive Rewards
* Ingame Prices & Loot
* Unique Event Maps

---

# **Huge Warzones**

Fight inside massive custom warzones designed for:

* Mace PvP
* Diamond SMP Combat
* Sword PvP
* Clan Battles
* Open World Fights

---

# **Join the Network**

Experience one of the most feature-packed European Minecraft networks with custom systems, balanced gameplay, unique PvP mechanics, and an active community.
